Preserve the CRO and product backlog as deferred evidence-backed work. Reconsider one bounded reversible implementation only after the authoritative candidate is unblocked, existing failures are repaired or explicitly closed, an isolated worktree and rollback path are available, measurement capacity is free, and security, attribution, and financial gates remain satisfied.
